title: The Muster Roll Audit
logline: A retired military paymaster living under an assumed identity across three systems is tracked down by veteran survivors seeking back-pay from a battle the admiralty covered up as a routine training accident.

roles.description: An aging clerical officer living in a quiet border system; plagued by nightmares and unpaid ledger debts.
A hardened veteran hired by a wounded veterans' lodge to collect twenty years of stolen disability pay.
A regional magistrate tasked with suppressing wartime pension fraud lawsuits to protect government bond ratings.
A fast armed scout skiff screening the veteran flotilla and tracing hyperdrive wakes.
A battle-scarred heavy escort flown by disabled ex-soldiers demanding their back wages.
A cold data bunker situated in a deep space relay gap holding sealed postwar military audit dockets.
A rundown hospice station in an outer rim mining cluster where disabled combat veterans gather.
An advocacy union of discharged infantry and gunners demanding their withheld wartime pensions.

public_situation: An aging bookkeeper in {system} is pursued across regional jump gates by bounty hunters claiming he holds embezzled regimental funds from an old campaign.
private_truth: The paymaster diverted millions in wartime disability pensions into private offshore trusts under orders from superiors who wanted a disastrous planetary siege erased from official history.

beats.public_change: A bounty bulletin targeting a former administrative clerk is posted across all transit lounges in {system}.

missions.reason: He hires an unaligned pilot to retrieve an encrypted ledger cylinder from a decommissioned archive vault before bounty hunters locate his safehouse.
missions.private_fact: The cylinder contains the authentic muster rolls of the wounded soldiers whose pensions were systematically falsified.

beats.public_change: The paymaster flees through the jump gate as the veteran militia corvette tracks his hyperdrive wake.

missions.reason: He hires the pilot to deliver decryption keys to the vault relay so the ledger data can be backed up before the militia intercepts them.
missions.private_fact: He wants the evidence saved because his own pension is tied to the fraudulent casualty write-off.

missions.reason: She hires the pilot to scan the archive vault antenna array to verify whether the ledger contains the stolen muster dockets.
missions.private_fact: She represents fifty maimed survivors who have lived in squalor for twenty years while their commanding officers drew executive dividends.

beats.public_change: The provincial marshal arrives with legal arrest warrants, demanding both the ledger and the paymaster be surrendered to the state.

missions.reason: He pays the pilot to intercept and destroy the veteran militia scout skiff before they can storm the paymaster's shuttle.
missions.private_fact: He has orders from the colonial governor to seize the ledger and incinerate it to prevent a multi-million credit class action lawsuit.

beats.public_change: The veteran corvette corners the paymaster's vessel outside the veterans' lodge station, broadcasting an open ultimatum.

missions.reason: He hires the pilot to escort his shuttle into deep space past the veterans' blockade so he can escape the region forever.
missions.private_fact: The tracker hails mid-flight offering to share the recovered pension bounty if the pilot delivers the paymaster and the ledger to the lodge.

player_choice.prompt: With the ledger secured and the old paymaster cornered, the pilot must decide whose hands receive the stolen records.

options.label: Deliver the ledger and paymaster to the veterans' lodge for justice
Turn the ledger over to the marshal to bury the scandal and claim the bounty
Release the authentic casualty muster rolls across regional public relays

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot turns over the ledger and the paymaster to the veterans' coalition.
resolutions.summary: {role:veterans_coalition} uses the ledger to force the colonial treasury into settling back pensions. {role:retired_paymaster} is placed in civil custody.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot recovered lost military muster ledgers, securing back pay for disabled war veterans.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot turns the ledger over to the provincial marshal.
resolutions.summary: {role:provincial_marshal} destroys the muster rolls, permanently extinguishing the veterans' lawsuit. {role:retired_paymaster} receives a quiet government stipend in exile.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot handed secret military casualty records to the state, ending a veteran lawsuit.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot broadcasts the authentic casualty muster rolls openly.
resolutions.summary: The public learns the admiralty stole veterans' pensions to balance wartime deficits. Protests erupt across three systems, collapsing the colonial cabinet.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot leaked wartime muster records, exposing government theft of veteran pensions.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot escorts the paymaster out of the region, or never intervenes.
resolutions.summary: {role:retired_paymaster} disappears into uncharted space with the ledger. {role:veterans_coalition} remains penniless and forgotten in outer mining hospices.

loose_threads.detail: The ledger includes an irrevocable depository certificate issued by a private offshore commercial trust.
The tracker's bounty license carries an emergency countersignature from an outer-ring miners' fraternal mutual society.

radio_hooks: Veteran advocacy coalition files regional injunction over withheld wartime service credits.
Provincial judicial authorities offer reward for former administrative clerk sought for questioning.
Discharged service personnel hold silent vigil outside colonial treasury offices in {system}.

voice_direction.retired_paymaster: Weary, pedantic, and frequently pauses while quoting fiscal regulations. Speaks in a low, trembling tone when asked about wartime casualties.
voice_direction.militia_tracker: Brusque, raspy, and speaks with cold clipped efficiency. Treats moral debates as distractions from financial settlement.
voice_direction.provincial_marshal: Smooth, authoritative, and speaks in measured legal euphemisms. Downplays historic atrocities as minor accounting oversights.
